name: Benamaurel (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist red with the crowned municipal arms of Benamaurel (chequy, a tower and tools) above seven yellow stars, the fly chequy of blue and white.
history: Municipal flag of Benamaurel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Benamaurel arms — chequy, tower and tools
seven stars in a row beneath the arms
